acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI exposes a first-class channel step and selects dev when no value exists.
The choice persists across restart and is shown in landing, status, install, upgrade, and launch views.
Unknown or unavailable channels produce typed recovery without silently becoming dev.
Development-only auth, signatures, and key management are visible warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: Keyboard, restart, human, and JSON cases pass at exact heads.
Independent review confirms no hidden authentication gate.

outputs.description: TUI channel selection and persistence receipt.

gates.description: Interactive and JSON TUI surfaces agree on channel selection and diagnostics.
